steps.instruction: IGN ON (wait for glow plugs), engine OFF. Keep steady.
Start the engine and blip the throttle (idle -> ~2000-2500 -> idle) several times.
Drive 0 -> 20-30 km/h and back a couple of times (safe area).
Turn the AC ON, wait, then OFF.
steps.label: AC Status

steps.instruction: Open the driver door, then close it.
steps.label: Door Status

steps.instruction: Left indicator ON for a few blinks, then OFF.
steps.label: Indicator Status

steps.instruction: Press and release the brake pedal several times.
steps.label: Brake Switch

steps.instruction: Press and release the clutch pedal several times.
steps.label: Clutch Switch

steps.instruction: Unbuckle, then buckle the driver seatbelt.
steps.label: Seatbelt Status

steps.instruction: Shift through the gears and back.
steps.label: Gear State

steps.instruction: Read the ODOMETER (km) and enter it.
steps.label: Odometer

steps.instruction: Estimate FUEL level (litres) and enter it.
steps.label: Fuel Level
